# AppSeal

> AppSeal is an external black-box security scanner ("trust seal") for AI-built apps and vibe-coded sites. Paste a URL - the engine runs 125 automated checks (leaked secrets, open databases, exposed admin panels, security headers and TLS, liveness, AI-trust hygiene) and returns a grade from A+ to E with a ready-to-paste fix prompt. Operated by an independent self-employed developer in Russia.

Site map:
- [Home and scanner](https://appseal.online/): paste a URL to run a free scan (1 scan/day per IP, demo target exempt)
- [Registry](https://appseal.online/registry): public showcase of sites graded A/A+ with auto-extracted descriptions
- [Stats](https://appseal.online/stats): anonymous aggregate results from mass scans of AI-built apps
- [Legal](https://appseal.online/legal): rules, privacy policy, data handling, opt-out contact
- [Telegram bot](https://appseal.online/bot): buy the Launch Pass via Telegram

## How scanning works
- Black-box scan of a publicly reachable URL; nothing is installed and no accounts are created
- The full report (per-check results, fix prompt, PDF) is private to the scan initiator via a secret key; the public view shows a verification card (host, grade, date)
- Launch Pass (one-time purchase, 7 days) unlocks unlimited scans, the full PDF report and an embeddable trust badge

## ru
AppSeal - «техосмотр» для приложений, собранных с ИИ: чёрный ящик-скан живого сайта на утечки секретов, открытые базы, дырявые админки, заголовки безопасности и признаки заброшенности. 125 проверок, грейд A+-E, бейдж доверия, публичный реестр.
